name: Warsong Labor Camp
summary: Warsong Labor Camp cuts Ashenvale timber for the growing Horde. Its Warsong loggers and orcish sentries work in southeastern Ashenvale, far from help and under threat from the forest's defenders.

sections.title: Timber for the Horde
sections.body: East of Fallen Sky Lake and southwest of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, Warsong loggers cut Ashenvale's dense timber. Durotar's dry plains offer little wood for building cities such as Orgrimmar, so the Warsong clan has pushed into these contested woods. Loggers and orcish guards work far from other Horde settlements, felling ancient trees while night elf scouts and Alliance warbands threaten the camp.

sections.title: A Vulnerable Outpost
sections.body: Warsong Labor Camp lies far from the main road and fortified bases such as Splintertree Post. Alliance raiders strike its working peons and watchmen, knowing help may be slow to arrive. Night elves see each felled tree as a desecration, and the camp remains a point of conflict in the war.

faq.q: Where is the Warsong Labor Camp located?
faq.answer: Warsong Labor Camp lies in southeastern Ashenvale, east of Fallen Sky Lake and southwest of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this camp?
faq.answer: Warsong loggers cut and process Ashenvale timber for buildings in Orgrimmar and other Durotar settlements.

faq.q: Why is the camp frequently attacked?
faq.answer: The camp is isolated and far from major Horde fortifications. Night elves oppose the cutting of their sacred forests, and Alliance raiders strike because nearby guards cannot offer swift help.

faq.q: Did Grommash Hellscream found this camp?
faq.answer: During the Third War, Warchief Thrall sent Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan into Ashenvale to harvest lumber. Warsong Labor Camp continues that work.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you depend on Ashenvale lumber to build and maintain Orgrimmar. The loggers work far from home in contested territory.
As a night elf, you see Warsong Labor Camp cutting into Ashenvale's ancestral groves to supply Durotar.
